total.name: DCAI revenue increase
total.quote: DCAI revenue increased $3.2 billion from Q3 2025

other_items.name: server revenue from ASP increases
other_items.quote: driven by higher server revenue, which increased $2.5 billion in Q3 2026 due to ASP increases of 54%

other_items.name: Other DCAI revenue
other_items.quote: Other DCAI revenue was $1.4 billion in Q3 2026, up $743 million from Q3 2025

input.note: The claim credits "higher server prices" as the main driver of DCAI revenue growth. The filing does not report "higher server prices" as a standalone figure. Instead, it reports that DCAI revenue increased $3.2 billion from Q3 2025, driven by higher server revenue of $2.5 billion (due to ASP increases of 54%) and Other DCAI revenue increase of $743 million. The filing further explains that "The majority of the increase in server ASPs resulted from a higher mix of premium products sold in Q3 2026, with demand-based pricing actions contributing to a lesser extent" and that "Server volume increased 10% compared to Q3 2025." Since the credited item (higher server prices) is not reported as a separate figure, reported=false and target=null. The $2.5 billion server revenue increase includes both price and volume effects, though the filing attributes it primarily to the 54% ASP increase.
